component.name: TSM Desktop App
component.summary: Download WoW auction data for the TradeSkillMaster addon

description.p: An unofficial Linux desktop client for TradeSkillMaster. It signs in to the TSM API, downloads auction house data for your realms, and writes the Lua files the TradeSkillMaster addon reads, so pricing data stays current in a World of Warcraft install running under Wine, Lutris, Proton or Steam.

ul.li: Finds World of Warcraft installs, including Lutris, Steam Proton and Faugus Launcher prefixes
Keeps auction data current in the background and writes AppData.lua atomically
An accounting dashboard for gold over time, sales, expenses and profit per item
Keeps the addons up to date and backs up TSM saved variables on a schedule
Stores your credentials in the system keyring, never in a config file

description.p: This is a community project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by TradeSkillMaster or Blizzard Entertainment.

screenshot.caption: Gold over time, with sales, expenses and profit per item
Auction data status for each realm
Scheduled backups of the addon's saved variables

description.p: Fixes an app that cancelled reboot and shutdown on KDE Plasma, and adds Flatpak, AppImage and Nix packaging.
